customers.segment: customer segment code, e.g. SME, LAM
customers.currency: customer currency code, e.g. EUR, CZK
gasstations.chainid: numeric ID of gas station chain
gasstations.country: country code of gas station location, e.g. CZE=Czech Republic, SVK=Slovakia
gasstations.segment: gas station chain segment, e.g. Value for money, Premium, Discount
products.description: product name/type in Czech, e.g. 'Rucní zadání' = Manual input, 'Nafta' = Diesel fuel, 'Special' = Special
transactions_1k.cardid: numeric card ID used in transaction (payment or loyalty card)
transactions_1k.gasstationid: numeric gas station ID referencing gasstations
transactions_1k.amount: quantity count of product units purchased
transactions_1k.price: total price of transaction (amount × unit price), not unit price
yearmonth.date: year and month in YYYYMM format, e.g. 201207=July 2012
yearmonth.consumption: numeric quantity consumed or purchased in the month
